items.title: 百度开源Unlimited-OCR：3B参数一次性解析100页文档，本地运行
items.en_title: China open-sourced a peanut-sized OCR that parses entire 100-page PDFs in one shot. Only 3B params. Runs locally.
items.full_text:
China open-sourced a peanut-sized OCR that parses entire 100-page PDFs in one shot..

It's called Unlimited-OCR. Only 3B params. Runs locally.

Every other OCR tool chops your doc into pages and loses the thread. this one reads the whole thing in a single pass.

→ One-shot "long-horizon" parsing (32K context window)
→ Multilingual, out of the box
→ 93% on the standard parsing benchmark (+6 over baseline)
→ <0.11 error rate past 40 pages
→ Runs 100% locally on your own hardware
→ Works with Transformers, vLLM, SGLang
items.author: thesupermanmx
items.summary: 百度开源Unlimited-OCR模型：仅3B参数（推理时5亿激活），32K上下文窗口一次性解析100页文档，支持多语言，93%标准基准得分（超基线6分），40页后错误率<0.11，完全本地运行。
items.analysis: 这对游戏开发的意义：大量游戏设计文档、策划表格、本地化文本可以一次性解析而不丢失跨页上下文。开源+本地运行意味着敏感文档无需上传云端。
items.recommendation: 百度开源3B参数OCR一次读完100页——本地运行超越所有分页方案

items.title: Google实验新特性html-in-canvas：在Canvas中渲染实时HTML为3D纹理
items.en_title: Google has solved a 20-year-old web problem with html-in-canvas - renders live HTML directly as a 3D texture
items.full_text:
Google has solved a 20-year-old web problem..

It's called html-in-canvas, a new experimental Chrome feature that renders live HTML directly as a 3D texture.

→ draws any DOM element straight into a canvas
→ full CSS still works, flexbox, grid, shadows, backdrop-filter, animations
→ text stays selectable, inputs stay typeable, screen readers still see it
→ auto syncs with your DOM on every paint
→ pipes into any WebGL shader
items.author: HowToPrompt__
items.summary: Google推出实验性Chrome特性html-in-canvas，解决了20年来的Web难题：将任意DOM元素实时渲染为Canvas中的3D纹理，保留完整CSS、可选择文本、屏幕阅读器兼容。
items.analysis: 对Web游戏开发的意义巨大：游戏内UI可以直接使用HTML/CSS渲染到3D场景中，无需将DOM元素转为纹理再贴图。Three.js/WebGL游戏的UI系统可能因此大幅简化。
items.recommendation: Google html-in-canvas：DOM直接渲染为3D纹理——Web游戏UI革命

items.title: 用Codex 5.6 Sol将初代暗黑移植为iPad触控版——已开源
items.en_title: I used Codex 5.6 Sol to make the original Diablo actually playable by touch on iPad. Open sourcing it all.
items.full_text:
I used Codex 5.6 Sol to make the original Diablo actually playable by touch on iPad.

Diablo was always point-and-click. Now your finger is the mouse. Tap gold on the floor and your character walks over and grabs it.

It's built on DevilutionX, the open-source Diablo engine a group of contributors has maintained for years. It already ran on iOS, with a virtual gamepad. What didn't exist was a version built around the touchscreen itself.

Open sourcing it all below.
items.author: chrissotraidis
items.summary: 开发者用Codex 5.6 Sol将初代暗黑破坏神通过DevilutionX引擎改造为iPad原生触控版：点击地面角色自动寻路拾取。完整开源。
items.analysis: AI辅助将经典游戏移植到新平台的案例越来越多。Codex在理解游戏输入逻辑并重新映射到触控方面展现了实用价值。开源意味着社区可以为更多经典游戏复刻触控版。
items.recommendation: Codex 5.6将初代暗黑改为iPad触控版并开源——AI辅助经典移植

**百度开源OCR一次读完100页文档**
Unlimited-OCR仅3B参数（推理时5亿激活），32K上下文窗口一次性解析整本文档，93%基准得分。完全本地运行，多语言支持。同日，BCI脑机接口玩黑神话悟空的视频引发热议，Google的html-in-canvas实验特性也为Web 3D游戏开发带来新可能。

**Palworld持续霸榜+IP扩张**
Palworld第二周末再次逼近百万同时在线，同时卡片游戏预售已达350万包（7月30日发布）。从Steam游戏到实体卡片，IP多元化变现路径清晰。

**行业动态密集**
AC黑旗重制首周300万销量验证经典翻新策略；FF14手游全球上线前被砍再证MMO移动化之难；Valve工程师警告零件涨价可能导致Steam掌机提价。

**独游创意爆发**
Walkable Cities单脚行走解谜获430万播放；Pigs and Wolf三只小猪物理守家获63万播放；Hytale展示WoW式地牢内容。
